sourceText:
Oven Baked Chicken Strips
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:24am

Ingredients




You will need:

2 boneless chicken breasts
1/2 cup oats
1/2 cup rice krispies
1/2 cup bread crumbs
1/2 inch piece of fresh ginger
1 cup flour
3 eggs (beaten)
1 teaspoon dried oregano
1 teaspoon paprika
olive oil

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees: 2 In a food processor combine the rice krispys, oats, bread crumbs and the piece of ginger. Give this a few good chops. 3 Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips. 4 Add the oregano and paprika to the flour and in 3 separate bowls place the bread crumb mixture, flour and eggs. 5 Dip the chicken breast strips first in the flour then in the egg wash and finally in the bread crumb mixture. 6 Place in baking pans and drizzle with olive oil. 7 Bake for about 30-35 minutes.

About


This recipe is light and tasty and goes great with a honey mustard sauce.
Enjoy!
